verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs say it offers an AI Gateway for connecting to AI models (netlify-docs-7), and that you can reach popular AI models from project code without managing API keys (netlify-docs-24). That covers the core idea of gateway-mediated model access. Nothing in the pack shows the scale (hundreds of models) or a single unified endpoint, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: evidence of hundreds of supported models, documentation of a single unified endpoint/API shape, a provider/model catalog, independent or hands-on validation.
